title: Agent Lifecycle Agent Revision Register Request
description: ALR-1106 Route 1 request (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:535-577): POST /api/v1beta/projects/{project_id}/agent-lifecycle/agent-revisions. Closes the prior draft's open blocker 1 (no producer for agent_revision_ref) -- the sole live public API minting path for kind=agent_revision refs; the bounded historical migration may invoke the same internal opaque-ref/record invariants once per safely resolved legacy revision key, never once per run. Route 3 (issue run-plan) only ever resolves an already-minted ref; it never creates one. `Idempotency-Key` (required header, pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{31,127}$, same durable-replay mechanism as Routes 2-3) is a request HEADER, not a JSON body field, and is therefore out of this document's scope -- a missing/malformed header is service_invalid (corpus cases agent_revision_register_missing_idempotency_key, idempotency_key_malformed_pattern_rejected), decided at the route layer, not by a generic JSON Schema validator (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:971). `agent_ref`/`identity_declaration` are both optional: omitting agent_ref mints a new logical Agent; omitting identity_declaration mints identity_state=UNKNOWN. `StableOpaqueRef` lives in agent_lifecycle_common_schema.json (ALR-1102 Terra review P2-2); `ClientDeclaredIdentityDescriptor`/`RequestOnlyRandomLabel` are new in this pass, added to the same shared common-schema location because the contract's request-only wire-type section (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:313-325) already treats them as reusable across Routes 1-2, not local to this one route file. Every property below carries its own x-disclosure annotation at its own JSON Pointer (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:406-409). The reserved VERIFIED/server_verified/[REGISTERED_PROVENANCE] identity tuple is structurally legal only in agent_lifecycle_common_schema.json#/definitions/IdentityStateAxisValue -- this request schema has no field through which a client could ever request or supply it; Route 1 has no Part 1 producer for it (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:562, corpus case agent_revision_register_emits_reserved_verified_without_producer, service_invalid, out of this Schema-only corpus's scope).

schema_version.description: Closed public wire-version discriminator (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:272, :547); never a product/version claim.

agent_ref.description: Optional. kind=agent, no version_id (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:548). Omit to mint a new logical Agent alongside this revision; supply an existing agent_ref to attach a new revision under an already-known logical Agent. The logical Agent has no table or model file of its own -- it is materialized only as the scoped agent_ref column on agent_lifecycle_records.

identity_declaration.description: Optional. The only admitted branch is the closed client declaration below; omission mints identity_state=UNKNOWN/client_attested/[REQUIRED_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN]. A Backend-managed selector, TypedOpaqueRef, identity-v2 snapshot id, Agent/Run id, ArtifactVersion id, raw fingerprint, database id, name, or path is schema-invalid or rejected before mint -- none is a Part 1 identity issuer (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:549, corpus case agent_revision_register_unknown_identity_source_or_mode). Modeled as a closed oneOf of exactly one member (matching the contract's exact-override manifest pointer identity_declaration/oneOf/0/properties/source, PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:415) so a future schema_version may add a second admitted branch without breaking this pointer.

source.description: The sole admitted discriminator (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:551-553); any other value is rejected by this closed branch (corpus case agent_revision_register_unknown_identity_source_or_mode).
